results.title: Casio launching three more square-shaped digital watches
results.description: Casio has revealed three new square-shaped digital watches in listings on one of its official websites. Each of these BGD-565 watches features a different grunge-inspired color scheme and comes with a stopwatch and an alarm.

results.title: Critical PHP Flaws Threaten Millions of Websites in New AI Security Test
results.description: Some organizations have temporarily taken websites and online services offline rather than leave vulnerable systems exposed.
